# One Pure SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (FIPS 205) verification input for timing, not for acceptance.
# It is an honestly generated signature of a throwaway test key (2,214 SHA-256 compressions
# to verify) in which the top authentication node below each of the seven hypertree layers
# was replaced, chosen by search (18 million trials per layer) to maximise the WOTS+ chain
# steps of that layer. It does not verify, and costs 3,174 compressions. A verifier cannot
# tell before doing the work, so this is what an attacker who picks the signature bytes can
# make a validator spend. The bound for this parameter set is 324 + 7 * 510 = 3,894
# compressions; the search reached 81.5 % of it.
# Fields per line: public_key context message signature (hex).
